sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Rose Gold-Plated Adjustable AD Criss-Cross Band Ring
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Elevate your style with this Rose gold-plated adjustable ring, featuring a stunning criss-cross band design adorned with sparkling American Diamond stones. A blend of glamour and comfort, this ring is ideal for daily wear, festive occasions, and gifting.
- Material: Brass base
- Plating: Premium Gold-plated finish
- Stone Type: Sparkling American Diamond (AD)
- Design: Criss-cross multiple band with stone accents
- Size & Fit: Adjustable – fits most finger sizes
- Style & Use: Perfect for daily wear, parties, weddings, and gifting
